scenario.task:
I have two separate requests today: submit a warranty claim for a malfunctioning device, and cancel my home phone line.

User Guide: Speak in English. Provide phone number 514-555-0199 and login code 384920. First, report your phone stopped charging with no screen or liquid damage for a warranty claim. Once that is processed, ask to cancel your home phone line, listen to the cancellation terms, and confirm the cancellation.
